land|Orzhov Basilica|Port Town.why: The Basilica is a black source and taps for two toward a 9-mana commander and 7-8-mana Sphinxes; Port Town would leave black at 15 sources.

land|Shineshadow Snarl|Fatehold Annex.why: Fatehold Annex enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker, and this deck runs none; the swap also trades a black source for a white-blue one.

land|Shineshadow Snarl|Port Town.why: Both enter untapped on a reveal; the swap trades a black source for a third white-blue one and leaves black at 15 sources.

land|Soured Springs|Port Town.why: Trades a black source for a third white-blue one; black would fall to 15 land sources for a commander and ten three-colour spells that need it.

land|Temple of Silence|Avengers Hangar.why: Lateral: both enter tapped, and the Hangar trades a black source and scry 1 for a third white-blue source and 1 life.

spell|Rise of the Dark Realms|Fellwar St.why: Rise is the finisher: the Ur-Sphinx mills every player each attack, Unesh bins half of every pile, and both sweepers fill every graveyard, so Rise returns a whole table of creatures. Fellwar Stone is a generic rock, and your copy is committed to another deck.

spell|Stroke of Midnight|Fellwar Stone.why: Stroke of Midnight is the deck's only instant answer to any nonland permanent (Despark needs mana value 4+). Ramp is already 12, and your Fellwar Stone is committed to another deck. A second Void Rend (buylist) is its upgrade.

spell|Stroke of Midnight|Void Rend.why: Void Rend is the better card here (uncounterable, no token for the opponent), but your only copy is in Y'shtola. A second copy is on the buylist to replace Stroke of Midnight.
